title: 宝塚記念の後に・キーワード②

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I beat you, you beat me not! I beat you, you beat me not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship bests Tosen Jordan with the haughty triumph of a child on the playground! She also gets a new clue, so that's nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They promise to have a rematch on a big stage next time. Meanwhile, the organizer of the search for Eden and the clues remains unknown.
